comment: THE USER MANUAL'S EXIT STATUS EXAMPLES ARE THE PRODUCT'S (kb/Work PB1610, PB4453). docs/manual/user-guide/run-units.md once said --run exits with 'the value of STOP RUN WITH ERROR STATUS n, 1 for an abnormal termination, 0 otherwise', which is wrong for WITH NORMAL STATUS 4 (exit 4) and for WITH ERROR alone (exit 1). The Conformance test StopGobackExitCodeTests.TheManualsExitStatusExamples_AreWhatTheProgramExitsWith runs each `proc` and expects its `exit` (DOC-A.1-192's mapping); scripts/docchecks/manual.py requires the page to print each `pageSpan`, so neither the page nor the mapping can move without the other.

examples.pageSpan: `STOP RUN WITH ERROR`, with no status
A main program's `GOBACK` takes the same phrases in COBOL 2023
